summary: Better as a Blitz: naming famous albums is fun, but in classic nearly every famous album that isn't top 10 costs a life.
reasons: Casual player gets Thriller, Back in Black, Dark Side, Rumours, The Bodyguard and Hotel California, then runs out of lives on 21, Abbey Road, 1989, Bad and The Wall.
The bottom of the top 10 (Come On Over, Bat Out of Hell, Saturday Night Fever, Eagles Greatest Hits) is old and obscure for players under 35.
Recent albums (1989, Midnights, Lemonade, Folklore) come from the streaming-era table: they cost a life in classic and score nothing in Blitz, which younger players will hit often.
fixes: Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band (#31) does not match 'sgt pepper' or 'sergeant pepper'. Add those short forms.
Beatles '1' (#18) has no alias; add 'beatles 1' and 'the beatles 1'.
Bat Out of Hell carries 'For Crying Out Loud' (a track on the album), not a name of the album. Drop it.
